chip.description: Sprite generator of Toaplan 1 hardware: up to 256 sprites of 8x8 to 128x128 pixels, sized through a lookup RAM, with a 4-bit priority level per sprite.
chip.notes: src/mame/toaplan/toaplan_fcu.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Toaplan 'FCU' sprite generator"). Toaplan 1 boards mark the part FCU-2.
